name: Baltimore
summary: Charm City on the Chesapeake — the harbor and the star fort where the national anthem was written, a top aquarium, cobblestoned Fell's Point, and steamed blue crabs.

lodging.name: An Inner Harbor or Fell's Point hotel
lodging.blurb: Inner Harbor for the sights; Fell's Point for the cobblestones and pubs.

foodMustTry.name: Steamed blue crabs & Old Bay
foodMustTry.blurb: A newspaper-covered table, a mallet, and a dozen crabs — the Maryland ritual.

days.label: Day 124 — The Inner Harbor
days.summary: Baltimore's revived waterfront and its aquarium.

item.title: National Aquarium
item.blurb: One of the best aquariums in the country — a rainforest, a shark ring, and dolphins on the Inner Harbor.

item.title: Historic Ships & Federal Hill
item.blurb: Board the USS Constellation, then climb Federal Hill for the harbor skyline view.

days.label: Day 125 — Fort McHenry & Fell's Point
days.summary: Where the anthem was born, and the old seaport.

item.title: Fort McHenry
item.blurb: The star fort whose defense in 1814 inspired Francis Scott Key to write 'The Star-Spangled Banner.'

item.title: Fell's Point & the Poe grave
item.blurb: Cobblestone streets and historic pubs, plus Edgar Allan Poe's grave nearby at Westminster.

days.label: Day 126 — Art, oddity & crabs
days.summary: A visionary museum, a ballgame, and a crab feast.

item.title: American Visionary Art Museum
item.blurb: A joyful museum of self-taught 'outsider' art — a giant whirligig out front sets the tone.

item.title: A Baltimore crab feast
item.blurb: Steamed blue crabs with Old Bay — the definitive Maryland meal (Orioles game at Camden Yards optional in season).

days.label: Day 127 — Down to Annapolis
days.summary: A short hop to the sailing capital.

commute.scenicNote: South to the Chesapeake and the Naval Academy.
